description: Rewrites the CLAUDE.md reporting sentence to cover failures, skips and the summary line.

patch.CLAUDE.md:
# Project rules

Run the test suite with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before reporting on test status.
Do not edit tests to make them pass.
Follow .claude/rules/verification.md when you report results.
Report a failing or skipped test as failing or skipped, and quote the runner summary line.
Never round a partial run up to a pass.
